Skúste to o chvíľu znova.', errorNotFound, errorGeneric and a no-listing error), the textarea placeholder at line 304 ('Opíšte, prečo nahlasujete tento inzerát…'), the submit-button label at line 426 ('Odoslať nahlásenie'), and the attachments label 'Prílohy (čoskoro)'. An English/Czech/German/Polish/Hungarian reporter on e.g. /en/report sees Slovak text mid-page. Fix (cloud-landable, frontend-only): move the MSG object + inline literals to t(...) keys under a 'report' namespace and add the keys to messages/{en,sk,cs,de,pl,hu}.json. No backend/DB work.
